title: Component specifications name DOM attributes the components no longer emit
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
Four specifications tell a reader to select on an attribute the component does not render.

- `components/Dropdown.md:154` puts `data-component="Dropdown"` on the root `<select>`. `src/components/Dropdown.tsx:56` puts it on the wrapper `<div>`, and the select carries none. Anyone selecting it to read `.value` gets a div.
- `components/Dropdown.md:64` puts `data-testid="dropdown-empty"` on the wrapper. `Dropdown.tsx:66` puts it on the select.
- `components/Card.md:116` and `components/ThemeToggle.md:101` both describe a `title` attribute. Neither component sets one, because the work recorded in CUI-016 moved every native tooltip onto the Tooltip component, which renders a bubble instead.
- `components/MermaidDiagram.md:99` lists the classes the error branch emits and omits `md-mermaid-error__message`, which `MermaidDiagram.tsx:208` renders and `src/styles/markdown-content.css` does not define.

The compile gate passes all of these, because it asserts that a documented hook renders rather than that the description of it is right.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.
